comments.author: Beomi
comments.body: This Pet skill shows the locations of all NPCs on the map when you use Surveying in land. (think it is helpful when you play Legacy content, especially when you are getting Land Battle clues.) This skill doesn't show the name of NPCs, isn't helpful when you are in dungeons.
